tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Lists the RevenueDot projects this key or account can use. A secret key sees its own project; an OAuth connection sees the project the user picked.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: list-apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: Lists the project's apps (one per store: app_store, play_store, test_store, stripe ...), with their ids. Product creation needs an app id.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: create-app
tools.title: Create app
tools.description: Creates an app in the project: test_store (simulated purchases, no store account needed), app_store with its bundle_id, or play_store with its package_name. Store credentials are not set here: the user adds them in the dashboard. Then call list-public-api-keys for the key the SDK uses.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

name.description: Name shown in the dashboard, e.g. Scanner iOS.

type.description: The store: test_store, app_store (iOS) or play_store (Android).

bundle_id.description: The iOS bundle id, e.g. com.example.app. Required for app_store.

package_name.description: The Android package name, e.g. com.example.app. Required for play_store.

tools.name: list-public-api-keys
tools.title: List public SDK keys
tools.description: Lists an app's public SDK key (appl_..., goog_..., test_...), the key the RevenueCat SDK is configured with in the app. It is public and ships inside the app; it is not a secret key and cannot change anything.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: list-products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Lists the project's products (store product ids per app), optionally for one app.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: create-product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Creates a product for one app. store_identifier is the product id in the store (App Store product id, Play subscription id such as pro:monthly, or any id for the Test Store). Set subscription_duration for subscriptions.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

app_id.description: The app the product belongs to (see list-apps).

store_identifier.description: The store's product id, e.g. pro_monthly.

type.description: Product type. Use subscription for auto-renewing plans.

subscription_duration.description: ISO 8601 period for subscriptions: P1W, P1M, P3M, P6M, P1Y.

tools.name: list-entitlements
tools.title: List entitlements
tools.description: Lists the project's entitlements (access levels such as pro) with the products that unlock each one.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: create-entitlement
tools.title: Create entitlement
tools.description: Creates an entitlement. lookup_key is what the app checks, e.g. customerInfo.entitlements["pro"].

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: attach-products-to-entitlement
tools.title: Attach products to entitlement
tools.description: Makes products unlock an entitlement. Attach every store's version of a plan (iOS, Android, Test Store).

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: list-offerings
tools.title: List offerings
tools.description: Lists the project's offerings with their packages and each package's products. The current offering (is_current) is what the SDK shows by default.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: create-offering
tools.title: Create offering
tools.description: Creates an offering (a set of packages the paywall shows). The project's first offering becomes current; set is_current to make this one current.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

is_current.description: Serve this offering to apps by default.

metadata.description: Free-form JSON the app can read (paywall copy, colors ...).

tools.name: create-packages
tools.title: Create package
tools.description: Creates a package in an offering. Use RevenueCat's standard lookup keys where they fit: $rc_monthly, $rc_annual, $rc_weekly, $rc_lifetime, $rc_six_month, $rc_three_month, $rc_two_month. Then attach products with attach-products-to-package.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

position.description: Order in the offering, 0 first. Default: last.

tools.name: attach-products-to-package
tools.title: Attach products to package
tools.description: Puts products in a package, at most one per app (e.g. the iOS, Android and Test Store monthly products in $rc_monthly).

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

eligibility_criteria.description: Google Play SDK eligibility; default all.

tools.name: get-customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Looks up a customer by app user id: active entitlements, attributes, subscriptions (gives_access says whether each one grants access now) and one-time purchases.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

customer_id.description: The app user id (any alias works).

tools.name: grant-customer-entitlement
tools.title: Grant entitlement to customer
tools.description: Grants a customer time-limited access to an entitlement until expires_at, for support or goodwill. The access ends by itself and can be revoked with revoke-customer-entitlement. The customer is created if new. Granting again with the same end date does nothing.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

entitlement_id.description: Entitlement id (entl...) or lookup key such as pro.

expires_at.description: When access ends: milliseconds since epoch, an ISO 8601 date, or a duration from now such as 7d, 1m or 1y.

tools.name: revoke-customer-entitlement
tools.title: Revoke granted entitlement
tools.description: Ends promotional access that was granted to a customer (with grant-customer-entitlement or the dashboard). Store purchases are not affected.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

customer_id.description: The app user id (any alias works).

tools.name: list-webhook-integrations
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: Lists the project's webhook integrations (URL, environment and event filters).

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: create-webhook-integration
tools.title: Create webhook
tools.description: Adds a webhook that receives RevenueCat-format events (INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, CANCELLATION, EXPIRATION ...). The response includes the signing secret once: tell the user to store it now, it cannot be shown again. A custom Authorization header for the endpoint is set in the dashboard.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

name.description: A label for the webhook, e.g. Backend.

environment.description: Only events from this environment. Default: both.

event_types.description: Only these event types, lower case (initial_purchase, renewal ...). Default: all.

tools.name: get-import-status
tools.title: Get import status
tools.description: After `npx revenuedot import` from RevenueCat: how many customers and subscriptions the project holds, and how many Google Play subscriptions still wait for a purchase token (per app).

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: get-project-health
tools.title: Get project health
tools.description: Setup health in one call: for each app whether the store credentials work and notifications arrive, plus whether webhooks are being delivered. Use it first when something looks wrong.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: get-metrics
tools.title: Get revenue metrics
tools.description: Without metric: the overview cards (MRR, revenue, active subscriptions, active trials, new customers, active customers, last 28 days, USD). With metric: that metric's daily history over `days` days.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

days.description: History length in days (default 28). Only with metric.

environment.description: Default production; sandbox shows Test Store and sandbox purchases.

tools.name: list-customers
tools.title: Find customers
tools.description: Newest customers first, or a search: an exact app user id, the $email attribute, or a store transaction id. Use it to find who a support request is about, then call get-customer.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

search.description: App user id, email or store transaction id (exact match).

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: list-transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: Every purchase, renewal, trial start and refund, newest first, with price and USD revenue. Optionally one customer's or one environment's.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: list-events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: The event log, newest first: the same events webhooks send (INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, CANCELLATION, BILLING_ISSUE, EXPIRATION ...). Filter by customer, type or environment to see why a customer lost access.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: set-customer-attributes
tools.title: Set customer attributes
tools.description: Sets attributes on a customer ($email, $displayName, or your own keys). A null value deletes the attribute.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

customer_id.description: The app user id (any alias works).

attributes.description: Name and value pairs; a null value deletes the attribute.

tools.name: delete-customer
tools.title: Delete customer
tools.description: Permanently deletes a customer and their data from this project (for a data-deletion request). Store subscriptions are not cancelled. Ask the user to confirm the app user id first.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

customer_id.description: The app user id (any alias works).

tools.name: extend-subscription
tools.title: Extend subscription
tools.description: Adds time to a subscriber's existing subscription for support or goodwill: by days, or until a date. Works on Google Play and App Store subscriptions (App Store needs a reason and at most 90 days). Take the subscription id from get-customer.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

extend_by_days.description: Days to add. Use this or extend_until.

extend_until.description: New end of access: milliseconds since epoch or an ISO 8601 date. Use this or extend_by_days.

tools.name: cancel-subscription
tools.title: Cancel subscription
tools.description: Cancels a subscription at the end of the paid period (the customer keeps access until then). Works where the store lets a server cancel (Google Play); others answer with an error that says so. Ask the user to confirm first.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: refund-subscription
tools.title: Refund subscription
tools.description: Refunds the latest charge and ends access immediately. Works where the store lets a server refund (Google Play); others answer with an error that says so. Money moves: only call it after the user said yes to this exact customer and amount.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: create-test-purchase
tools.title: Create Test Store purchase
tools.description: Simulates a purchase lifecycle in the project's Test Store for one app user, through the same pipeline as a real purchase (events, transactions, webhooks). Never touches Apple or Google. Use it to check that entitlements and webhooks work.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

app_user_id.description: The app user id to buy as; created if new.

product_id.description: Product id (prod...) or store identifier of a Test Store product.

offset_days.description: How many days ago it started.

tools.name: archive-offering
tools.title: Archive offering
tools.description: Hides an offering from apps without deleting it (it can be unarchived in the dashboard). The current offering cannot be archived.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: list-webhook-deliveries
tools.title: List webhook deliveries
tools.description: Delivery attempts for one webhook, newest first, with status, attempts, HTTP status and last error. Filter by status to find failures.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the id of the last item of the previous page (from next_page).

tools.name: retry-webhook-delivery
tools.title: Retry webhook delivery
tools.description: Sends a failed or pending webhook delivery again now.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: send-test-webhook
tools.title: Send test webhook
tools.description: Sends a TEST event to a webhook integration so the user can see it arrive. The webhook must be enabled.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: delete-webhook-integration
tools.title: Delete webhook
tools.description: Deletes a webhook integration and its delivery history. Events stop being sent to its URL.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: verify-store-credentials
tools.title: Verify store credentials
tools.description: Checks the Apple or Google credentials already saved for an app by calling the store, and says whether they work. It never accepts or returns a key: credentials are entered in the dashboard.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: get-app-store-settings
tools.title: Get app store settings
tools.description: An app's store notification setup: notification_url (paste it into App Store Connect or the Google Play Pub/Sub push subscription), notification_forward_url, when the last notification arrived and whether it was processed, the last forward, and track_new_purchases. Credentials show only whether each one is configured.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

tools.name: update-app
tools.title: Update app
tools.description: Changes an app's name and, for App Store and Google Play apps, notification_forward_url (store notifications are copied there, e.g. to RevenueCat during a migration; an empty string or null turns forwarding off) and track_new_purchases (record purchases the SDK never reported). Store credentials are not changed here: the user enters them in the dashboard.

project_id.description: RevenueDot project id (proj...). Optional when the key or account has exactly one project.

name.description: New name shown in the dashboard.

notification_forward_url.description: https URL that receives a copy of every store notification; empty string or null turns forwarding off. App Store and Google Play apps only.

track_new_purchases.description: Create customers for store purchases the SDK has not reported yet. App Store and Google Play apps only.
